segments.environment: A compact bedroom with white walls, light tile flooring, and a large window at the far end with floral curtains drawn to the side. Clothes hang to dry outside the window, and a wall-mounted air conditioning unit is above the window frame. Along the right wall is a single bed with a beige patterned fitted sheet where my roommate, wearing strawberry-patterned white pajamas, sits cross-legged behind a white foldable bed desk. A closed gray MacBook and a wireless mouse rest on the bed desk. To the right in the foreground, a light-wood study desk is equipped with an attached bookshelf holding books, potted plants, and a display case with miniature figurines; on the desk surface are a white electric fan, a power strip with chargers, an AC remote, a hair straightener, a glass bottle, and paper products. In the foreground sits a purple office desk chair. To the left sits a white three-tier rolling utility cart loaded with items and a low bedside table with an iPad and smartphone lying flat with screens turned off, alongside an open rack hanging clothes. Ambient indoor lighting is on with no background media playing.
segments.speech: 感觉不是很稳，是为啥？是哪个环节出现了？
